name: Sun Dogs
description: Pale suns in a blue sky, each inside its halo with a mock sun at either side, strung together row by row on one long parhelic line.

code.style: --rule: ( --hr: @rn(31, 39)%; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--color2) 0 12%, transparent 46%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); opacity: @r(0.6, 0.9); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @var(--hr) @var(--hr) at 50% 50%, transparent 82%, #000 95%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(transparent 49.3%, #000 49.3% 50.7%, transparent 50.7%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 8.5% 8.5% at 50% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 4.6% 7.6% at calc(50% - @var(--hr) - 1.5%) 50%, #000 45%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 4.6% 7.6% at calc(50% + @var(--hr) + 1.5%) 50%, #000 45%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
